args.title: checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

- **Confirmed the failure**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back**: The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was the broken deploy). The rollback deployed v2.3.0 to all three regions and completed successfully.
- **Opened incident**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) titled "checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0," describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Next steps worth considering: verify service health has recovered post-rollback, and investigate what broke in v2.3.1 before attempting another release.
